items.q: We listened to people like Stravinsky, Jacque Ibert, Ravel, Debussy

ctx.x: Oh, yes, you know, in those days, we listened to music that had nothing to do with jazz as many of the great players had, black or white. We listened to people like Stravinsky, Jacque Ibert, Ravel, Debussy,
